A source is registered on a connector. `planned` connectors have no working adapter and can never be activated. A fresh deployment starts with the connectors marked *active by default*; a source admin can activate others from the Connectors page.

What each status means, and what has been certified, is in the [connector support matrix](/reference/connector-support-matrix/).

| Connector | Key | Status | Active by default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Atlassian Confluence / Jira](/reference/connectors/atlassian/) | `atlassian` | planned | no |   |
| [Google BigQuery](/reference/connectors/bigquery/) | `bigquery` | planned | no |   |
| [DigitalOcean Spaces](/reference/connectors/digitalocean_spaces/) | `digitalocean_spaces` | native | no |   |
| [Elasticsearch](/reference/connectors/elasticsearch/) | `elasticsearch` | native | no | governance not exercised by any test stack |
| [HTTP / REST](/reference/connectors/generic_rest/) | `generic_rest` | production | yes |   |
| [GitHub](/reference/connectors/github/) | `github` | native | yes | governance not exercised by any test stack |
| [GitLab](/reference/connectors/gitlab/) | `gitlab` | native | no | governance not exercised by any test stack |
| [Google Drive / Workspace](/reference/connectors/google_workspace/) | `google_workspace` | native | no |   |
| [MariaDB](/reference/connectors/mariadb/) | `mariadb` | native | no |   |
| [MongoDB](/reference/connectors/mongodb/) | `mongodb` | planned | no |   |
| [Microsoft SQL Server](/reference/connectors/mssql/) | `mssql` | planned | no |   |
